profile.summary: Lorenzini Apparels Limited designs, manufactures, markets, and distributes ready-made garments in India. The company offers formal, semi-formal, and casual wears for men and women under the Monteil brand name. It sells its products through retail outlets, online, and third-party e-commerce marketplaces. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in New Delhi, India.
